description: nhflow_1d_si_nh_wetdry_breaking four cells wide (y 0 - 0.8 m): the coupled eta-phi solve by multigrid and FGMRES (j_dir 1) with the wet pattern iteration (A 537 1) and the second-order time levels (A 505 1). The first pass takes the wet pattern of the hydrostatic estimate, a further pass starts FGMRES from the solution of the pass before and keeps the preconditioner.
covers: nhflow_momentum_SI::nh_solve (wet pattern iteration from the pattern of the estimate, A 537 1)
nhflow_momentum_SI::nh_solve_mg (warm start of a further pass, its stopping residual, the preconditioner kept)
